articles.title: How a Nigerian Startup Became an Fintech Unicorn
articles.summary: African fintech unicorn Moniepoint was founded in 2015 and has grown into one of the continent's standout success stories. From powering payments for small businesses to building critical financial infrastructure, the company has scaled rapidly and earned its place among Africa's most valuable tech firms. Bloomberg's Jennifer Zabasajja spoke to Felix Ike, the company's co-founder and CTO, about Moniepoint's journey from startup to unicorn, and what it takes to build at scale in Africa's fast-evolving tech landscape. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: 25 African Startups to Watch | Bloomberg Next Africa
articles.summary: On this edition of Next Africa, we bring you Bloomberg's 2026 African startups to watch list. From Egypt to Mauritius, these companies are racing to solve some of the continent's toughest challenges. Plus, we hear from Moniepoint co-founder and CTO, Felix Ike, on building one of Africa's leading fintech platforms. We also speak with venture capital investors on opportunities and challenges of investing in the continent. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: OpenAI Has Discussed Adding Citigroup, JPMorgan to Bank Lineup for IPO
articles.summary: OpenAI has spoken with banks including Citigroup Inc. and JPMorgan Chase & Co. about working on its upcoming initial public offering, according to people familiar with the matter.
articles.author: Ryan Gould, Shirin Ghaffary

articles.title: SpaceX Lowers IPO Valuation Target | Bloomberg Tech 5/29/2026
articles.summary: Bloomberg’s Tim Stenovec breaks down why SpaceX is coming back down to Earth with a slightly lower valuation in its IPO. Plus, Anthropic closes a funding round at a whopping $965 billion valuation, surpassing OpenAI for the first time in the AI race; and Dell surges after the hardware giant's outlook far surpassed Wall Street estimates. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Anthropic Valuation of $965 Billion Passes OpenAI
articles.summary: Anthropic raised $65 billion in a funding round that valued the AI company at $965 billion including the new investment, eclipsing rival OpenAI’s value for the first time. Bloomberg's AI reporter Shirin Ghaffary joins Tim Stenovec on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: SpaceX Said to Cut IPO Valuation Goal to at Least $1.8 Trillion
articles.summary: SpaceX is currently targeting a valuation of at least $1.8 trillion in its initial public offering, according to people familiar with the matter, as Elon Musk’s rocket and artificial intelligence company nears its debut.
articles.author: Kiel Porter, Edward Ludlow

articles.title: Why The SpaceX IPO Is Unlike Any Other
articles.summary: What began as a rocket startup is now a big bet on satellites, AI and Mars. With a projected valuation of at least $1.8 trillion, SpaceX’s IPO could reshape markets. But is Wall Street rushing in too fast? (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Anthropic raises $65 billion, nears $1T valuation ahead of IPO
articles.summary: Anthropic has closed a $65 billion Series H round at a $965 billion post-money valuation, marking what could be the AI startup's final private fundraise before a highly anticipated IPO.
articles.author: Rebecca Bellan

articles.title: DeepZero Says IPO Success Signals Strong Belief in AI
articles.summary: Beijing DeepZero Chairwoman Grace Huang says the market’s reaction to the its Hong Kong IPO is a sign that people are recognizing the power of AI. DeepZero's shares surged more than 260% on its debut on May 27. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Africa Startups Turn Inward as US AI Boom Drains Venture Capital
articles.summary: African startups are rewriting their funding playbook as the global artificial intelligence boom pulls venture capital toward the US, forcing emerging markets to compete for cash.
articles.author: Rivaldo Jantjies

articles.title: Anthropic reaches valuation of $965bn, beating OpenAI to become world’s most valuable AI firm
articles.summary: Claude’s parent company’s $65bn in latest funding round underscores vast sums of money still flowing into industryAnthropic, the AI firm behind the Claude chatbot, announced on Thursday it had raised $65bn in funding to value the company at $965bn post-money. The move makes Anthropic the world’s most valuable AI startup, eclipsing its competitor OpenAI.The deal marks an exceedingly successful period of growth for Anthropic, which was once considered to be a smaller player in the global AI arms race. The widespread adoption of its products by large enterprise businesses, especially following its release of powerful coding assistants late last year, has turned it into a dominant player in the industry. Continue reading...
articles.author: Nick Robins-Early

articles.title: Anthropic Nears $1T Valuation And Leapfrogs OpenAI On Unicorn Board With $65B Funding Round
articles.summary: Generative AI company Anthropic announced on Thursday that it has raised $65 billion in a Series H funding round, more than doubling its post-money valuation to a staggering $965 billion.
articles.author: Judy Rider

articles.title: Memory Chip Giant CXMT Heads for China’s Biggest IPO Since 2022
articles.summary: Memory chip maker ChangXin Memory Technologies Inc. has received approval from the Shanghai Stock Exchange for an initial public offering that’s on track to be the biggest in mainland China since 2022, in a milestone for one of the key technologies of the artificial intelligence buildout.
articles.author: Charlie Zhu, April Ma

articles.title: SpaceX Investor Powerlaw to Debut on Nasdaq as IPO Race Heats Up
articles.summary: Powerlaw Corp., a closed-end fund that owns stakes in Elon Musk’s SpaceX and artificial intelligence firm OpenAI, is going public without raising any capital in the latest public vehicle to cater to retail investors’ clamor for exposure to the hottest private tech companies.
articles.author: Anthony Hughes

articles.title: Plenty of Ways to Play AI Trade in Europe, Goldman Sachs Says
articles.summary: Sharon Bell, equity strategist at Goldman Sachs, discusses the artificial intelligence trade and why she thinks European stocks, and not just tech firms, can benefit. She speaks on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Airbnb-backed WeRoad raises $58M to take its group travel platform to the US
articles.summary: WeRoad, the Milan-based group travel startup, has raised a $58 million Series C round led by Airbnb as it prepares for its first major expansion outside Europe. The funding brings the company’s total capital raised to roughly $100 million and will finance WeRoad’s push into the U.S., beginning with Austin. The new investment reflects a […]
articles.author: Lauren Forristal

articles.title: Bridging Africa’s Innovation Gap: From Potential To Power
articles.summary: While Africa’s innovation ecosystem is growing rapidly, it still faces major challenges, writes Mind the Bridge's Alberto Onetti, who argues that the continent's weak electrical grid infrastructure and limited domestic venture capital will need large-scale public and private investment to unlock its economic and technological potential.
articles.author: Guest Author

articles.title: Fireworks AI in Talks for Funding at $15 Billion Valuation
articles.summary: Fireworks AI, a startup that helps companies run artificial intelligence models, is in talks to raise a new round of funding that would value the company at $15 billion, according to people familiar with the matter.
articles.author: Rebecca Torrence

articles.title: Starship’s path to reusability looks murky after SpaceX’s S-1
articles.summary: SpaceX's recent IPO and Starship rocket test flight delivered two big data points that offer a realistic vision for the coming years — and one that may disappoint both the company's boosters and its critics.
articles.author: Tim Fernholz
